set.body: See docs/plans/terminal-workspace.md, V3. Add optional Textual TUI and plain feed; integrate connect HOST --view --project PROJECT after foreground authentication. Separate viewer runs beside agent; attach resolves project or explicit root and persists scoped monitoring. Add offline mode, project selection, tabs on narrow terminals, keyboard-only navigation, safe text, visible freshness and reconnect instructions. q/Ctrl-C restores terminal and releases inspection leases without cancelling jobs or stopping persistent subscriptions. Validate optional dependency/TTY before MFA, keep base CLI/MCP imports UI-free, and test cached rendering under slow remote calls.
set.title: V3: terminal viewer and connect --view lifecycle
